cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll formally conclude our coffee before you go. Keep your coat off until I release you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My bus is due. I'm putting it on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, prepared departure. Choose the seat nearest the door and I'll make my decision there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cafe's closing. They've told us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll do this walking toward your stop. You set the pace; I'll keep up. When I say you're free to go, you can stop matching my stride.

relationship.evidence: B2 has a real bus and B4 obeys cafe staff; A adapts around both constraints to keep the friend present.

heightening.evidence: A5 person claiming release power must keep up with the person supposedly waiting for it.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 matching-my-stride claim exposes the reversal of who is following whom, earned by the conceded pace.
